research.title: Evidence Sensitivity in Retrieval-Augmented Question Answering
bullets: Designed controlled experiments varying passage relevance and distractor placement to evaluate answer consistency in retrieval-augmented question answering.
Analyzed unsupported answers and citation mismatches across retrieval conditions, distinguishing failures associated with missing evidence from misleading context.

research.title: Calibration and Selective Prediction Under Text Domain Shift
bullets: Designed experiments comparing temperature scaling and confidence-based abstention for text classifiers evaluated across source and target domains.
Analyzed reliability diagrams, risk-coverage curves, and classwise errors to characterize calibration behavior under vocabulary shifts and changing label distributions.

publications.title: Confidence-Based Abstention for Text Classification Across Domains: Threshold Transfer and Error Analysis
Assessing Temperature Scaling Under Vocabulary and Label Distribution Shifts in Text Classification

work.title: Inventory and Order Processing Support
bullets: Checked incoming deliveries against packing slips, organized stock locations, and flagged discrepancies for review during routine inventory reconciliation.
Prepared order paperwork, maintained filing records, and coordinated collection schedules with staff to support daily dispatch operations.

projects.title: Comparative Sentiment Classification with Sparse and Neural Representations
bullets: Implemented sentiment classifiers using term-frequency inverse-document-frequency features with logistic regression and a convolutional model over learned word embeddings.
Compared models using stratified evaluation splits and macro-averaged scores, examining errors involving negation, mixed sentiment, and infrequent vocabulary.

projects.title: Sequence Labeling for Named Entity Recognition
bullets: Implemented conditional random field and bidirectional recurrent baselines for named entity recognition using consistent tokenization and shared training partitions.
Compared entity-level precision and recall, inspecting boundary errors and unseen entity mentions to assess differences between feature-based and contextual representations.
